dict.string: OLCR uses Calendar to view and manage the events you request in chat.
OLCR uses Calendar to view and manage the events you request in chat.
OLCR Mail reads requested messages and sends emails only when an agent is asked to send them. Sent messages always include an AI-agent disclosure.
OLCR uses the microphone for voice input and, only while hands-free mode is enabled, local wake-word detection.
OLCR uses macOS on-device speech recognition when you select macOS as the voice input engine.
OLCR uses the camera only while you enable hands-free gestures to recognize your hand movements locally.
OLCR captures the screen only while you start screen perception, so it can observe visual changes and help with local computer tasks.
